mapper.select: SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN actual_time END), 0) AS avgTime, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2), 0) AS completionRate, COALESCE(ROUND(1000.0 / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN actual_time END), 0), 2), 0) AS efficiency FROM delivery_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND district IS NOT NULL AND district != '' GROUP BY district ORDER BY orders DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalRevenue, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN actual_time END), 0) AS avgDeliveryTime, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' OR status = 'DELIVERING' THEN cargo_weight ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalDistance FROM delivery_order WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT cargo_type AS cargoType, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM delivery_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND cargo_type IS NOT NULL AND cargo_type != '' GROUP BY cargo_type ORDER BY orderCount DESC
